name: Denmark
prevalence_note: Politiet and bank warnings 2025-2026: fake bank security asking for MitID approvals or a move to a security account, fake police or tax staff asking for card details, and fake technical support.
cross_border_note: Cross-border vishing rings spoof Danish (+45) bank, police, and agency numbers; under Digitaliseringsstyrelsen's September 2026 anti-fraud telecom executive order, Danish operators are required to block unverified foreign inbound calls spoofing Danish numbers, pushing scammers toward SMS callback lures and mule couriers.

scams.name: Falsk bankrådgiver: godkend med MitID
scams.name_en: Fake bank adviser asking for a MitID approval
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department reports a suspicious transfer and asks the owner to approve in MitID, give a code or move money to a security account.
scams.legit_en: Danish banks never ask customers to approve MitID requests they did not start or to move money to a security account.
bait_tactics: Sige at telefonen genstarter og bede dem forklare det en gang til, roligt
Spørge hvilken dag overførslen var og hvor stort beløbet var

scams.name: Falsk politi eller Skattestyrelsen: identitetsmisbrug
scams.name_en: Fake police or tax office about identity misuse
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as the police or the tax agency speaks of identity misuse or an investigation and asks for card details, the CPR number and a MitID approval.
scams.legit_en: The police and Skattestyrelsen never ask for card details or MitID approvals by phone.
bait_tactics: Sige at man lige skal finde brillerne og bede dem gentage det langsomt
Spørge hvornår misbruget skulle være sket

scams.name: Falsk teknisk support: overtage kontrollen
scams.name_en: Fake tech support taking control of the computer
scams.signals_en: A caller from a technical department says the computer has a security problem and asks to download a program so they can take control, then to log in to online banking.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about security problems and never ask to control a computer.
bait_tactics: Sige at computeren starter meget langsomt og spørge hvad der skal stå på skærmen
Spørge hvilken fejlbesked de har fået
